title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Integrated development-humanitarian programme: Climate-proofing agricultural, energy, and food security practices in Luuq, Belet Xawa, Dollow, Garbaharey, and El Wak counties, Gedo region’ programme, implemented by Trócaire, aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. The activities and objective include, DRR committees established and supported, participatory action plans for disaster risk management in place and, early warning information distributed in an accessible manner and, set up new water systems (shallow well), including solarization to utilize clean energy. So, communities can adopt measures and approaches which strengthen their resilience to cope with climate crises and shocks. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Increase the resilience of poor and marginalised rural communities by mitigating and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation.- Strengthen climate disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have - Disaster Risk Management reduces the vulnerability of households and communities to the impacts of climate change, supporting them to adapt to a changing climate and the associated hazards e.g. increased flooding, drought and cyclones etc. Preparedness involves measures to reduce the impacts of these hazards, further contributing to climate adaptation
